# Lab deploy pipeline fails on migrate

## Contexto

The lab deploy job has been failing since the migration step started running
before the schema advisory lock is released. The failure is reproducible on the
`main` pipeline; the run that first showed it is
https://github.com/trazadera/modernaize/actions/runs/32082281184 and every
subsequent run fails the same way at the `migrate` step.

## Diagnosis

The offending change is commit 4f2a9be in `app/src/main/resources/db/migration`,
which moved the lock acquisition after the first DDL statement. See
`scripts/deploy/lab-migrate.sh` for the wrapper that swallows the exit status,
which is why the pipeline reports the failure only at the smoke-test stage.

## Definition of Done

- The lab deploy pipeline is green on `main`.
- `scripts/deploy/lab-migrate.sh` propagates a non-zero migrate exit status.
- A regression test covers the advisory-lock ordering.

## Enlaces

- Related: MDZ-198 (advisory lock refactor)
